name: bytes-removed-inside-an-anchor-validation
violates: spec §3.4 and §7: a verifier refuses malformed bytes; it never aborts on them
notes: Found by a differential run of the two verifiers at code 19a04df5. Four bytes removed inside the anchor core's validations. The C++ process ended with SIGSEGV in the codec's array parser. The two verifiers meet different faults first (a validation that is not canonical; an unknown record type after it), so no reason is asserted.
